atoms.name: Connectives and equivalences
atoms.one_line:
$p\Rightarrow q\equiv
eg p\vee q\equiv
eg q\Rightarrow
eg p$; the converse and inverse are not equivalent.

atoms.name: Truth tables: valid, satisfiable, models
atoms.one_line: Valid: true in every model. Satisfiable: true in some. Count models by enumerating rows.

atoms.name: Entailment
atoms.one_line: $KB\models\alpha$ iff every model of $KB$ satisfies $\alpha$ iff $KB\wedge\neg\alpha$ is unsatisfiable iff $KB\Rightarrow\alpha$ is valid.

atoms.name: Conjunctive normal form
atoms.one_line: Remove $\Rightarrow,\Leftrightarrow$, push $\neg$ inward (De Morgan), distribute $\vee$ over $\wedge$.

atoms.name: Resolution
atoms.one_line: From $A\vee\ell$ and $B\vee\neg\ell$ derive $A\vee B$; deriving the empty clause proves unsatisfiability.

atoms.name: Quantifiers
atoms.one_line: $\forall$ pairs with $\Rightarrow$, $\exists$ pairs with $\wedge$; $\neg\forall x\,P\equiv\exists x\,\neg P$.

atoms.name: English to first-order logic
atoms.one_line: 'All A are B': $\forall x(A\Rightarrow B)$; 'Some A is B': $\exists x(A\wedge B)$; 'except' means an iff; order of nested quantifiers matters.

atoms.name: Validity in first-order logic
atoms.one_line: $\forall xP\Rightarrow\exists xP$ is valid; $\exists xP\Rightarrow\forall xP$ is not; $\forall x\exists y$ does not give $\exists y\forall x$.

atoms.name: Unification
atoms.one_line: Find a substitution making two literals identical; fail on constant clash or occurs check.
